cv_metrics.decision_reason: Selected 'ServiceDetector' baseline because best trained model 'Random Forest' (strict-LOSO mean F1 0.401) did NOT beat ServiceDetector (0.475 ± 0.284, required margin > 0.759) by a clear margin (> 1 std).
cv_metrics.selection_rule: Pick model with best mean strict-LOSO F1; ties broken by RCA top-3, then simpler model. Selection uses CV results only. If best trained model does not beat ServiceDetector by > 1 std, keep ServiceDetector as the live engine.
